actuation_data.actreg.desc: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) for actuation data records

actuation_data.actoperref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing operation(OperReg). Ties actuation data to a particular operation

actuation_data.actdetref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing robot_details(BotDetReg). Connects to a specific robot’s details

actuation_data.tcpxval.desc: NUMERIC(7,2) storing TCP (Tool Center Point) X-coordinate in a relevant unit (mm, cm)

actuation_data.tcpyval.desc: REAL capturing TCP Y-coordinate as a float

actuation_data.tcpzval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for TCP Z-coordinate

actuation_data.tcp_rxval.desc: NUMERIC(6,2) rotation around X-axis for the tool center point

actuation_data.tcp_ryval.desc: FLOAT(6) rotation around Y-axis, approximate float

actuation_data.tcpspeedval.desc: NUMERIC(8,2) capturing linear speed of the TCP (e.g., mm/s)

actuation_data.tcpaccelval.desc: REAL storing acceleration at the tool center point

actuation_data.pathaccmmval.desc: NUMERIC(6,3) path accuracy in millimeters (difference from taught path)

actuation_data.orienterrdegval.desc: REAL measuring orientation error in degrees

actuation_data.payloadwval.desc: NUMERIC(6,2) specifying payload weight in kg if relevant

actuation_data.payloadival.desc: FLOAT(4) capturing payload inertia or moment, if used

actuation_data.m1currval.desc: NUMERIC(6,2) motor 1 current draw in amps, for example

actuation_data.m3currval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for motor 3 current

actuation_data.m6currval.desc: FLOAT(4) approximate float for motor 6 current

actuation_data.m3voltval.desc: FLOAT(6) approximate float for motor 3 voltage

actuation_data.m6voltval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for motor 6 voltage

joint_condition.jcondoperref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing operation(OperReg) to link these condition metrics

joint_condition.j1tempval.desc: NUMERIC(5,2) capturing the temperature of Joint 1’s motor or housing

joint_condition.j2tempval.desc: REAL storing Joint 2 temperature. May have platform-limited precision

joint_condition.j3tempval.desc: NUMERIC(6,3) for Joint 3 temperature with 3 decimals

joint_condition.j4tempval.desc: FLOAT(4) approximate float for Joint 4 temperature

joint_condition.j6tempval.desc: FLOAT(6) approximate float for Joint 6 temperature

joint_condition.j1vibval.desc: NUMERIC(5,3) measuring vibration amplitude for Joint 1

joint_condition.j3vibval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for Joint 3 vibration

joint_condition.j4vibval.desc: NUMERIC(5,3) decimal for Joint 4 vibration amplitude

joint_condition.j6vibval.desc: FLOAT(4) approximate float for Joint 6 vibration measure

joint_condition.j1backval.desc: NUMERIC(5,4) describing measured backlash in Joint 1

joint_condition.j2backval.desc: NUMERIC(6,3) backlash for Joint 2 with different precision

joint_condition.j4backval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for Joint 4 backlash

joint_condition.j6backval.desc: FLOAT(7) approximate float for Joint 6 backlash

joint_performance.jperfoperref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing operation(OperReg). Associates these joint performance metrics with a specific operation

joint_performance.joint_metrics.desc: JSONB column. Groups performance metrics for each joint, including angle, speed, and torque, organized by joint number for easier access

maintenance_and_fault.upkeepactuation.desc: PRIMARY KEY (VARCHAR(20)) referencing actuation_data(ActReg). Ties maintenance/fault record to actuation data

maintenance_and_fault.faultcodeval.desc: VARCHAR(25) storing a code for the specific fault (e.g., 'F1234')

maintenance_and_fault.issuecategoryval.desc: VARCHAR(22) labeling the fault or issue category (e.g., 'Communication', 'Electrical', 'Mechanical', 'Software')

maintenance_and_fault.faultpredscore.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float rating the probability or severity of fault

maintenance_and_fault.faulttypeestimatio.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing the likely fault type (e.g., 'Motor', 'Joint', 'Gearbox', 'Controller')

maintenance_and_fault.rulhours.desc: INT storing Remaining Useful Life in hours if predicted

maintenance_and_fault.upkeepduedays.desc: SMALLINT capturing days until next scheduled maintenance is due

maintenance_and_fault.upkeepcostest.desc: DECIMAL(9,3) estimated cost for upcoming maintenance or repair

mechanical_status.mechactref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing actuation_data(ActReg). Relates mechanical status to actuation context

mechanical_status.gb2tempval.desc: REAL capturing gearbox 2 temperature as a float

mechanical_status.gb3tempval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for gearbox 3 temperature

mechanical_status.gb6tempval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for gearbox 6 temperature

mechanical_status.gb3vibval.desc: FLOAT(4) approximate float for gearbox 3 vibration

mechanical_status.gb6vibval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for gearbox 6 vibration

operation.operreg.desc: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) for an operation record (previously 'OperationRegistry')

operation.operbotdetref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing robot_details(BotDetReg). Links this operation record to a specific robot’s details

operation.operrecref.desc: VARCHAR(20) referencing robot_record(RecReg), tying the operation to the main robot record

operation.totopshrval.desc: DECIMAL(9,2) capturing total operating hours for the robot in this operation context

operation.apptypeval.desc: VARCHAR(40) describing the application type (e.g., 'Assembly', 'Painting', 'Palletizing', 'Material Handling', 'Welding')

operation.currprogval.desc: VARCHAR(40) naming the current program loaded or running on the robot

operation.progcyclecount.desc: INT counting how many times the program cycle has executed

operation.cycletimesecval.desc: DECIMAL(8,3) measuring cycle time in seconds (precision to three decimals)

operation.axiscountval.desc: SMALLINT storing how many axes (joints) the robot uses in this operation environment (e.g., 7, 6, 5, 4)

performance_and_safety.conditionindexval.desc: DECIMAL(6,4) summarizing an index of overall robot condition (health)

performance_and_safety.effectivenessinde.population: could be throughput or success rate
performance_and_safety.effectivenessinde.desc: NUMERIC(4,2) capturing how effectively the robot is performing (could be throughput or success rate)

performance_and_safety.qualitymeasureval.desc: FLOAT(5) approximate float for quality measurement or pass rate

performance_and_safety.energyusekwhval.desc: NUMERIC(7,2) referencing energy used in kWh over a certain period

performance_and_safety.pwrfactorval.desc: FLOAT(4) a float for power factor if the robot system uses AC power

performance_and_safety.airpressval.desc: DECIMAL(6,3) measuring compressed air pressure if pneumatic components are used

performance_and_safety.toolchangecount.desc: INT referencing how many times a tool was changed on the robot

performance_and_safety.toolwearpct.desc: REAL storing estimated tool wear percentage

performance_and_safety.safety_metrics.desc: JSONB column. Captures safety-related metrics and events, such as safety state, zone violations, emergency stops, collisions, overloads, speed violations, and c

robot_details.botdetreg.desc: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) referencing robot_record(RecReg). Ties detailed specs to an existing robot record

robot_details.mfgnameval.desc: VARCHAR(60) describing the manufacturer’s name (was 'Manufacturer') (e.g., 'FANUC', 'Yaskawa', 'KUKA', 'ABB', 'Universal Robots')

robot_details.modelseriesval.desc: VARCHAR(40) capturing the robot’s model series/designation

robot_details.bottypeval.desc: CHAR(15) labeling the broad type of robot (e.g., 'Delta', 'Collaborative', 'Cartesian', 'SCARA', 'Articulated')

robot_details.payloadcapkg.desc: DECIMAL(9,2) specifying the maximum payload the robot can handle in kilograms (e.g., 5, 200, 100, 50, 20, 3, 10)

robot_details.reachmmval.desc: SMALLINT storing the robot’s reach in millimeters (distance from base)

robot_details.instdateval.desc: DATE indicating when this robot was installed (was 'InstallationDate')

robot_details.fwversionval.desc: VARCHAR(25) logging the firmware version installed on the robot’s controller

robot_details.ctrltypeval.desc: VARCHAR(40) referencing the type or brand of controller used (was 'ControllerType')

robot_record.recreg.desc: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) uniquely identifying this record in the robot database. Was 'RecordRegistry' previously

robot_record.rects.desc: TIMESTAMP marking when the record was created or logged. Must be present (NOT NULL)

robot_record.botcode.desc: VARCHAR(25) referencing or naming the robot code or ID. Required field (NOT NULL)

system_controller.systemoverseeractuatio.desc: PRIMARY KEY (VARCHAR(20)) referencing actuation_data(ActReg). Identifies this system controller record uniquely

system_controller.controller_metrics.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates performance and environmental metrics of the system controller, including load, memory usage, thermal levels, and cabinet conditions

maintenance_and_fault.grain: maintenance and fault record per actuation

performance_and_safety.grain: performance and safety record per actuation

relations.result: difference of position and path errors, mm
